therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: T-cell exhaustion reversal and anti-tumor immune response activation
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: participants with locally advanced or metastatic urothelial bladder cancer receiving second-line or beyond treatments
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: objective response rate (ORR) assessed by independent review facility according to RECIST v1.1

results.effect_size: ORR 15.8% (95% CI: 11.9-20.4) by IRF RECIST v1.1; ORR 19.7% (95% CI: 15.4-24.6) by investigator modified RECIST
results.target_engagement_evidence: Mean Cmax 364 mcg/mL; steady-state Cmin levels achieved by cycle 3-4 (120-147 mcg/mL)
biomarker_changes: 42.4% of participants developed anti-therapeutic antibodies to atezolizumab
results.dose_information: 1200 mg IV infusion on Day 1 of 21-day cycles until disease progression or unmanageable toxicity

context.duration: treatment until progression, maximum follow-up 24.48 months
